observations: body L1-L25: the end of the note e) on p. 17, l. 33, begun on p. 175.

body L6, L11: «Mare Viride» of L11 is printed heavier than the same words in L6, as by a heavier impression at the beginning of the line; the letters are those of the italic, and it is transcribed as italic.
body L17: the dash of «yamā dh–» at the end of the line is the long dash of the name (5.4 pt), as in «dh–sūph» earlier in the line; the name goes on in the next line.
body L18: the Syriac words are printed in the Serto script, the dālath with its dot below; the edition sets them in an Estrangela type.
body L26: the head of the notes on chapter 7, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.

body L28-L36: the figure stands at the left of lines 28 to 36, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the meridian ABGD as a circle; the equator AEG, the horizon BED and the circle of declination PTHZ through the solstitial point H as arcs of circles fitted to the printed strokes; the line from the pole P through E to the pole Z in dashes, each drawn where it printed, with the short pieces that join the strokes at P, E and Z (between the junction at E and the dash beside the letter E one dash of the series did not print). The letters are bold italic.

body L35: the formula is Menelaus' theorem for the spherical triangle THE cut by the meridian ABZ: sin AT : sin AE = (sin TZ : sin ZH) × (sin HB : sin BE), written with the chords of the double arcs; checked, the ratios are as printed. With AE = 90°, TZ = 90°, ZH = 90° − ε and HB = 90° − HE it gives cos HE = sin P cos ε.
notes_left L5: «riq» is printed heavier than the rest of the italic of the note, as by a heavier impression at the beginning of the line; transcribed as italic.
notes_left, notes_right: the rule over the notes is 114.4 pt long; a thin vertical rule stands between the two columns of notes. The signature 23 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
